title: TSM Intelligence Platform: Workforce, L1, SAP and Executive, in one loop
story: WORKFORCE > L1 > SAP > EXECUTIVE > BACK TO WORKFORCE
audience: Enterprise buyers evaluating TSM across verticals
businessPain: Workforce systems, frontline ticketing, enterprise ERP and executive reporting are usually separate tools with no shared intelligence loop between them.
valueProposition: One governed intelligence loop, in the real application: understand the signal, connect it across systems, and hand a person the decision.
desc: Captured fail-loud across four real TSM apps: Workforce Intelligence, the L1 Ticket Copilot, the SAP Strategist and the Operational OS executive view. The workforce scenario toggle and the SAP trace are preset/demo configurations, not live computation; the Operational OS executive package needs a connected case, which this environment does not have, so it is shown in its real empty state.
_note: Frames come from capture-intelligence-platform.js (12 steps, replacing the old intelligence-platform-demo.spec.js). Captions and narration describe only what each step asserts; see intelligence-platform-capture.json for the on-screen text. stage indexes chain. Narration numbers are written as words.

states.caption: Workforce Intelligence Platform
states.narration: TSM Intelligence Platform connects workforce intelligence, frontline operations, enterprise systems and executive decision-making through one architecture, in the real application. We start with Workforce Intelligence.

states.caption: Switching between two preset workforce scenarios (demo configuration)
states.narration: This view switches between two preset workforce scenarios, each with its own readiness and compliance configuration. That is a demo configuration, not a live candidate lookup.

states.caption: L1 Ticket Copilot
states.narration: That intelligence has to reach the point where work actually happens: the L one Ticket Copilot, running in the real application.

states.caption: Ticket classified; closure blocked until evidence is in
states.narration: An offboarding ticket is entered. TSM classifies the task type and shows closure as blocked, because the required evidence is not in yet. The technician decides what happens next.

states.caption: SAP Strategist
states.narration: The same intelligence pattern extends into the enterprise, in the SAP Strategist.

states.caption: Customer journey started
states.narration: Starting the journey traces a business object across commerce, CRM, master data, CPQ, approval and downstream operations.

states.caption: Business object trace
states.narration: Instead of viewing each system on its own, TSM shows the relationships between them: the business object trace, stage by stage.

states.caption: Downstream impact
states.narration: The same data condition can propagate across multiple application boundaries downstream.

states.caption: Enterprise impact
states.narration: The enterprise impact view shows that propagation across systems, not just the health of one application on its own.

states.caption: Executive decision package assembled
states.narration: The strategist assembles the evidence needed for an executive decision. The decision itself stays a business action: investigate, remediate, or escalate.

states.caption: Operational OS executive view (no case connected)
states.narration: The Operational OS brings recovery data into one executive package once a case is selected. This environment has no case connected yet, so the package view is shown empty, honestly.

states.caption: Back at Workforce Intelligence: the loop closes
states.narration: Human decision, action, evidence, outcome: that is the loop at the center of TSM, from workforce intelligence through frontline execution to the executive view, and back again.
